GECKO GODS ULTRAWIDE (32:9) - INSTALL
=====================================

This fix is a MelonLoader mod. No game files are modified - the mod corrects the
camera framing, UI scaling and window resolution at runtime.

Tested at 5120x1440 (32:9) on Gecko Gods, Unity 6000.0.65f1, IL2CPP.


STEP 1 - Install MelonLoader
----------------------------
Download MelonLoader x64 (v0.7.3 or newer) from:
    https://github.com/LavaGang/MelonLoader/releases

Extract "MelonLoader.x64.zip" directly into your Gecko Gods folder, so that
"version.dll" and the "MelonLoader" folder sit next to GeckoGods.exe:

    C:\Games\Solo\Gecko Gods\
        GeckoGods.exe
        version.dll          <- from the zip
        MelonLoader\         <- from the zip


STEP 2 - Launch the game ONCE
-----------------------------
Run GeckoGods.exe. A MelonLoader console window appears and spends 30s-2min
generating IL2CPP assemblies (this is normal, let it finish). Wait until the
game reaches the main menu, then quit.

This step is required before the mod will work.


STEP 3 - Install the mod
------------------------
Create a "Mods" folder next to GeckoGods.exe if it does not exist, and copy
GeckoUltrawide.dll (in this folder) into it:

    C:\Games\Solo\Gecko Gods\Mods\GeckoUltrawide.dll


STEP 4 - Play
-------------
Launch the game. About 2 seconds after loading it switches itself to
5120x1440 borderless, corrects the camera FOV, and normalizes menu scaling.


CONFIGURATION
-------------
After the first run with the mod, edit:

    <game>\MelonLoader\UserData\MelonPreferences.cfg

under the [GeckoUltrawide] section. Useful keys:

    ForceWidth / ForceHeight   target resolution (default 5120 / 1440)
    ForceBorderless            true = borderless fullscreen
    ForceResolution            false = leave resolution alone
    FixCameraFov               false = leave the camera alone (stock Unity framing)
    FixHudScaling              false = leave menu scaling alone
    Enabled                    false = disable all fixes

For a different ultrawide (e.g. 3440x1440) just change ForceWidth/ForceHeight -
the FOV math adapts to whatever aspect the screen actually is.


UNINSTALL
---------
Delete <game>\Mods\GeckoUltrawide.dll  (or set Enabled = false).
To remove MelonLoader too, delete version.dll, dobby.dll, MelonLoader\ and Mods\.


TROUBLESHOOTING
---------------
Game closes instantly and MelonLoader\Latest.log just stops mid-way:
that is a native IL2CPP crash. Look at the last "[bc]" breadcrumb line in the
log - it names the exact call that died. See ../notes.md section 4.
